hyperedges.name: order_lifecycle
hyperedges.detail: Order created pending -> coupon applied (coupon_redemptions) -> manual proof submitted (payment_proofs) or culqi webhook (payment_events) -> admin approval marks paid -> enrollment created; cron expires stale orders.

hyperedges.name: certification_flow
hyperedges.detail: Enrollment -> attendance recorded -> exam attempts (bounded by max_attempts/lockout_hours) graded server-side against question_options -> passed attempt drives certificate issuance with snapshotted credential text and pdf_key.

hyperedges.name: admin_operations
hyperedges.detail: assertRole(['admin']) guards the admin section; pagos_page reviews pending proofs (approve/reject), certificados_page lists and revokes certificates; both delegate to billing/certification modules.

hyperedges.label: Kit de componentes UI sobre Base UI + cva
Exam attempt lifecycle (start, answer, grade, submit)
Certificate Lifecycle (emit, render PDF, verify, revoke)
Billing payment approval → access revocation → email flow
Certification issuance → unique code → PDF → R2 storage flow
Enrollment guard → attendance → course progress flow

hyperedges.type: Fase 6 reembolso: transacción atómica que revierte orden, inscripción, comisión y certificado
Modelo de negocio: academia propia, pago manual peruano, comisión 30%, ventana 30 días
Fase 5 certificados: emisión idempotente con snapshots, PDF perezoso con QR, verificación pública y revocación compartida

nodes.label: Admin Reembolsos Page
nodes.rationale: Only paid orders can be refunded; refunding revokes the student's course access.

nodes.label: Registro Page
nodes.rationale: Turnstile captcha token is passed via the x-captcha-response header on signup; after account creation the user is redirected to email verification.

nodes.label: Landing Page
nodes.rationale: Core value proposition: live Zoom classes in Peru time, downloadable materials, a course exam, and a publicly verifiable certificate.

nodes.label: Curso Detalle Page
nodes.rationale: Enrollment is not yet implemented; logged-in users see 'Próximamente' instead of a buy CTA.

nodes.label: Public Certificate Verification Page
nodes.rationale: Unauthenticated page exposes the student's full name, so robots noindex is set to keep it out of search engines.

nodes.label: Session Detail Page
nodes.rationale: Zoom link is only enabled once the session is live; for upcoming sessions the link becomes available 10 minutes before class.

nodes.label: Student Exam Preview Page
nodes.rationale: Attempt limits enforced: retry until maxAttempts, then locked out until desbloqueaA; passing once grants certificate.

nodes.label: Exam Attempt Page
nodes.rationale: Time is enforced server-side: an expired attempt is auto-closed and graded with the answers submitted so far; reading the clock per request is intentional in a Server Component.

nodes.label: Refund Workflow
nodes.rationale: Admin searches an order by number or student email; only 'paid' orders can be refunded, and refunding revokes access.

nodes.label: Role-Based Post-Login Redirect
nodes.rationale: After login the user is routed by role: admin→/admin/pagos, instructor→/instructor, otherwise→/mi-aprendizaje.

nodes.label: Learning Value Proposition
nodes.rationale: Four-step model marketed on the landing page: live classes, downloadable materials, exam, verifiable certificate.

nodes.label: Per-Course Question Bank
nodes.rationale: Each course owns a bank of questions from which exams are assembled, with configurable exam settings.

nodes.label: Exam Draft Publish Gate
nodes.rationale: While the exam is in draft status, students cannot see it; publishing makes it visible and runnable.

nodes.label: Zoom Access Gate
nodes.rationale: The Zoom join link is gated by session state: only live sessions expose the link, and upcoming sessions unlock it 10 minutes before class.

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative Exam Timer
nodes.rationale: Exam time is enforced by the server, not the client; an expired attempt is auto-closed and graded with whatever was answered.

nodes.label: Certificate Verification
nodes.rationale: A public code-based page lets anyone verify a certificate (student, course, instructor, academia, final score) without auth, hence robots noindex.

nodes.label: Per-Session Materials
nodes.rationale: Each class session may have downloadable materials (fileKey or externalUrl) shown to enrolled students.

nodes.label: Enrollment Flow Pending
nodes.rationale: Enrollment is not implemented yet; logged-in users see 'Próximamente' and guests are sent to /login.

nodes.label: Página de pago de orden
nodes.rationale: Si totalCents > env.YAPE_MAX_CENTS se resalta la transferencia bancaria sobre Yape/Plin por superar el límite diario de billeteras.

nodes.label: API: URL presigned del comprobante de pago (admin)
nodes.rationale: Endpoint solo-admin que devuelve la URL presigned GET del comprobante desde R2, sin transmitir el archivo por el servidor.
nodes.norm_label: api: url presigned del comprobante de pago (admin)

nodes.label: API: handler de Better Auth
nodes.rationale: Monta el handler de better-auth bajo /api/auth/[...all] mediante toNextJsHandler.

nodes.label: API: PDF público de certificado
nodes.rationale: Endpoint público sin autenticación con X-Robots-Tag noindex. Re-verifica revokedAt después de generar/subir el PDF para cerrar la ventana de carrera donde una revocación puede ocurrir durante la generación (que tarda segundos).

nodes.label: API: cron expira órdenes vencidas
nodes.rationale: Autenticación por header Authorization Bearer con env.CRON_SECRET.

nodes.label: API: cron recordatorios de sesiones
nodes.rationale: Autenticación por header Authorization Bearer con env.CRON_SECRET.

nodes.label: API: health check
nodes.rationale: Liveness simple: SELECT 1 contra la DB; responde 503 si la base está caída.

nodes.label: API: URL presigned PUT de comprobante de pago
nodes.rationale: Presigned PUT directo al bucket R2 para que el cliente suba el comprobante sin exponer credenciales; valida propiedad de la orden y restricciones de archivo.
nodes.norm_label: api: url presigned put de comprobante de pago

nodes.label: API: URL presigned PUT de material de sesión
nodes.rationale: Presigned PUT para materiales de sesión; verifica canManageCourse del instructor/admin sobre el curso.
nodes.norm_label: api: url presigned put de material de sesion

nodes.label: API: crear orden (solo tests)
nodes.rationale: Endpoint solo para pruebas; deshabilitado en producción mediante guard de NODE_ENV.

nodes.label: UI Card (compuesto)
nodes.rationale: Card compuesto (Header/Title/Description/Action/Content/Footer) sobre div con data-slot y CSS vars --card-spacing.

nodes.label: UI Dialog
nodes.rationale: Dialog basado en Base UI con Portal/Overlay/Popup y botón de cierre reutilizando Button.

nodes.label: UI Toaster (sonner)
nodes.rationale: Toaster de sonner con tema sincronizado vía next-themes e iconos lucide por tipo de notificación.

nodes.label: Métodos de pago (yape/plin/transferencia)
nodes.rationale: Métodos soportados: yape, plin, transferencia bancaria. Se recomienda transferencia si el monto supera el límite diario habitual de Yape/Plin (env.YAPE_MAX_CENTS).

nodes.label: Cloudflare Turnstile (anti-bot)
nodes.rationale: Servicio de verificación anti-bot de Cloudflare; widget renderizado en el cliente, token entregado por callback.

nodes.label: Drizzle DB Instance
nodes.rationale: Selects TEST_DATABASE_URL and uses a single-connection pool (max:1) under NODE_ENV=test so tests run against an isolated database; otherwise DATABASE_URL with a pool of 10.

nodes.label: User Creation CLI
nodes.rationale: Admin/dev CLI to create or update users with a role (student/instructor/admin); instructor/admin roles get an auto-approved instructor profile so they can immediately create courses; passwords are re-hashed via better-auth context and must be at least 8 chars.

nodes.label: Database Seed Script
nodes.rationale: Seeds demo data for local development of a Peruvian live-class academy: admin/instructor/student users, categories, an 'Excel desde cero' course with 4 Zoom class sessions, and yape/plin/transferencia payment destinations.

nodes.label: User Table
nodes.rationale: better-auth manages identity; the app adds a role column defaulting to 'student' for role-based access control.

nodes.label: Account Table
nodes.rationale: Stores per-provider credentials including the hashed password for the 'credential' provider (used by the user creation CLI to reset passwords).

nodes.label: Instructor Profiles
nodes.rationale: Instructor profile has a commissionRate (default 30.00%) plus bank details for payouts; status pending/approved gates whether the instructor can create courses.

nodes.label: Courses
nodes.rationale: Course carries a commissionRateOverride to allow per-course commission changes; prices are stored in integer cents (PEN).

nodes.label: Class Sessions
nodes.rationale: Live Zoom classes with isFreePreview flag for the first session and recording support; status lifecycle scheduled -> live -> completed/cancelled.

nodes.label: Session Materials
nodes.rationale: CHECK constraint material_source_xor enforces exactly one source per material (fileKey XOR externalUrl) so a material always has a single storage origin.

nodes.label: Orders
nodes.rationale: Orders expire (expiresAt) while pending so unpaid carts/orders are cleaned up; supports manual provider (yape/plin/transferencia proof) or culqi card payments.

nodes.label: Order Items
nodes.rationale: Title and commission (commissionRate, commissionCents, netCents) are snapshotted at purchase time so later price or commission changes do not retroactively alter past sales.

nodes.label: Payment Proofs
nodes.rationale: Partial unique index on (method, operation_number) WHERE status <> 'rejected' blocks duplicate proof submissions while still allowing a student to resubmit after a rejection.

nodes.label: Payment Events
nodes.rationale: Idempotency/audit log of provider webhooks (e.g. culqi) keyed by unique providerEventId so webhooks can be replayed safely.

nodes.label: Exams
nodes.rationale: Anti-cheating / retake policy: passingScore 70, maxAttempts 3, lockoutHours 24, and shuffleQuestions/shuffleOptions on by default; one exam per course (courseId unique).

nodes.label: Exam Attempts
nodes.rationale: Unique (enrollmentId, attemptNumber) enforces the attempt limit; expiresAt and time limits bound a live attempt window.

nodes.label: Certificates
nodes.rationale: Certificate is a snapshot (studentName, courseTitle, instructorName, academyName, hours, finalScore) so it stays valid even if course data later changes; code is unique for verification and pdfKey holds the generated PDF in R2; supports revocation.

nodes.label: Payouts
nodes.rationale: Period-based (periodStart/periodEnd) payout batches for instructors with draft -> paid lifecycle.

nodes.label: Instructor Earnings
nodes.rationale: One-to-one with an order item (unique orderItemId); gross/commission/net computed at sale and status moves pending -> available -> paid/reversed.

nodes.label: Session Reminders Sent
nodes.rationale: Unique (enrollmentId, classSessionId, kind) ensures each 24h/1h reminder for a session is only sent once.

nodes.label: Auth Client (better-auth/react)
nodes.rationale: Client-side counterpart of the better-auth server; baseURL from NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL and shares the same session/role model as the server.

nodes.label: Better-Auth Server
nodes.rationale: role is an additionalField with input:false so roles are set server-side only, never by the client; requires email verification on sign-up (custom verify-email template via modules/notifications); Cloudflare Turnstile captcha protects /sign-up/email from bots.

nodes.label: Lima Date/Time Utilities
nodes.rationale: All times rendered in America/Lima (es-PE) for the Peruvian academy; a session is 'live' from 10 minutes before its start until it ends, else upcoming/past.

nodes.label: Money Utilities (PEN)
nodes.rationale: Money handled in integer cents to avoid float rounding; solesToCents validates input and throws on invalid/negative amounts; formatPEN renders 'S/ ...'.

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2 Storage Client
nodes.rationale: S3-compatible R2 bucket stores user-uploaded files; 5-minute presigned URLs keep the bucket private while allowing direct upload/download without exposing secrets.

nodes.label: Slug Utilities
nodes.rationale: Slugs normalized via NFD + diacritic strip; uniqueSlug appends -2, -3 ... suffixes until free; empty input falls back to 'curso'.

nodes.label: Assessment server actions (exam/question CRUD, attempts)
nodes.rationale: Locks editing of the exam/question bank while an attempt is in progress (assertSinIntentosEnCurso). Concurrent double-submit of iniciarIntento is resolved by recovering the in_progress attempt created by the winning request after checking SQLSTATE 23505 on the error or its .cause (DrizzleQueryError), because Postgres invalidates the aborted transaction (25P02). Used questions cannot be edited/deleted (ON DELETE no action on exam_attempt_questions) and are archived via isActive=false; deleting the last active question auto-unpublishes the exam. responder deliberately does not revalidatePath so an in-progress exam is never re-rendered, and never returns isCorrect.

nodes.label: cerrarIntento: grade and close exam attempt
nodes.rationale: Deliberately not a 'use server' module: it is invoked by the enviarIntento action and by the Server Component when a timed-out attempt is auto-submitted, so it must not become a public endpoint. Idempotent: a submitted attempt returns its stored score without recomputing. Emits a certificate when the attempt passes.
nodes.norm_label: cerrarintento: grade and close exam attempt

nodes.label: Assessment read queries (bank, attempt, results)
nodes.rationale: getIntentoParaResolver never selects questionOptions.isCorrect nor questions.explanationMd so the answer key cannot leak to the client mid-attempt. cargarIntentoPropio returns null for another user's attempt so callers cannot distinguish 'not found' from 'forbidden'.

nodes.label: Assessment domain service (grading, shuffle, eligibility, schemas)
nodes.rationale: calcularNota trusts the isCorrect persisted by responder instead of re-comparing options, keeping the answer key server-side. Shuffling is deterministic: FNV-1a hash + mulberry32 PRNG + Fisher-Yates reproduce the same order from the same seed; the option-order seed derives from attemptId:questionId so reloading the page does not re-shuffle. Attempt lockout follows spec §6.6.
nodes.norm_label: assessment domain service (grading, shuffle, eligibility, schemas)

nodes.label: CuentaRegresiva countdown timer
nodes.rationale: Purely cosmetic timer: the server is the authority on exam time; on reaching zero the page reloads and the server auto-submits the expired attempt.

nodes.label: IntentoRunner
nodes.rationale: Optimistic radio selection with rollback to the previous value if responder fails; warns the student that unanswered questions count as incorrect on submit.

nodes.label: QuestionList
nodes.rationale: Archived questions (isActive=false) are hidden from the bank but kept in the database for future auditing.

nodes.label: Auth guards: roles, enrollment, course management
nodes.norm_label: auth guards: roles, enrollment, course management

nodes.label: Billing server actions (orders, proofs, approvals)
nodes.rationale: aprobarPago is idempotent for already-paid orders so the approval email is not re-sent. Enrollment is reactivated with onConflictDoUpdate instead of onConflictDoNothing so a refunded-then-repurchased enrollment does not strand a paying student without active access (all guards filter on status='active'). Detailed coupon redemption (coupon_redemptions) is deferred to a future Phase 6 coupons UI.

nodes.label: expireStaleOrders cron job
nodes.rationale: Deliberately NOT a 'use server' module so Next.js does not register it as an unauthenticated public endpoint; it is invoked only from a CRON_SECRET-protected API route (src/app/api/cron/expirar-ordenes/route.ts).

nodes.label: Billing domain service (totals, coupons, commissions, proof validation)
nodes.norm_label: billing domain service (totals, coupons, commissions, proof validation)

nodes.label: AdminProofReview
nodes.rationale: Warns the admin to verify the payment in the Yape/bank app, not from the uploaded image, since the screenshot itself is untrusted.

nodes.label: Server-authoritative exam timing
nodes.rationale: The client countdown is cosmetic; the server owns the deadline and auto-submits expired attempts, so a paused or malicious client cannot buy extra time.

nodes.label: Answer-key secrecy during an attempt
nodes.rationale: isCorrect and explanationMd are excluded from every in-progress query and never returned by responder, keeping the answer key server-side until the attempt is submitted.

nodes.label: Deterministic seeded shuffle
nodes.rationale: FNV-1a + mulberry32 PRNG + Fisher-Yates make attempt ordering reproducible from a seed; the option-order seed derives from attemptId:questionId so reloads do not reshuffle.

nodes.label: Manual payment proof review workflow
nodes.rationale: Payments are manual (Yape/Plin/transfer) secured by Turnstile and admin review before enrollment and instructor earnings are granted; earnings become available only after a holding period (EARNING_AVAILABLE_DAYS).

nodes.label: sendEmail Function
nodes.rationale: Never throws; every send (success or failure) is persisted to emailLog and the result is surfaced as {ok:boolean} so callers can react without crashing.

nodes.label: Nodemailer SMTP Transport
nodes.rationale: Mechanism: single nodemailer transport configured from env (SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASSWORD, MAIL_FROM); SMTP_USER is optional and authentication is only attached when present.

nodes.label: emailLog Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: Design decision: every outgoing email is written to the emailLog table (userId, toEmail, template, subject, providerId, status sent/failed, error) so email delivery is auditable and failures are traceable.

nodes.label: paymentProofReceivedTemplate
nodes.rationale: Admin-facing alert (not a buyer email) pointing reviewers to /admin/pagos.

nodes.label: sessionReminder1hTemplate
nodes.rationale: Optionally embeds the Zoom join link via escapeAttr when zoomUrl is present.

nodes.label: sessionReminder24hTemplate
nodes.rationale: Optionally embeds the Zoom join link via escapeAttr when zoomUrl is present.

nodes.label: verifyEmailTemplate
nodes.rationale: Link expires in 24h; message reassures non-signups to ignore.

nodes.label: escapeHtml HTML-Escaping Pattern
nodes.rationale: Design pattern: every template locally defines an escapeHtml helper and escapes all user-derived interpolation to prevent HTML injection in emails; attribute values reuse the same escaper.

nodes.label: {subject, html} Template Contract
nodes.rationale: Shared data contract: templates return {subject, html} which matches the SendEmailInput fields consumed by sendEmail (subject, html, template).

nodes.label: revocarAcceso Server Action
nodes.rationale: Admin-only refund flow: sets order+enrollment to refunded, reverses instructor earnings, revokes the certificate (and deletes its R2 PDF), then emails the buyer only if the order was not already refunded.

nodes.label: In-Transaction Idempotency Check
nodes.rationale: WHY: the eligibility SELECT that decides idempotency is repeated INSIDE the transaction (same pattern as aprobarPago in billing/actions.ts) so two overlapping calls to revocarAcceso can't double-send the refund email - the second tx blocks on the orders UPDATE and then sees status='refunded' and returns early. A cheap precheck outside the tx only short-circuits 'not found / not paid' without paying the tx cost.

nodes.label: buscarOrdenParaReembolso
nodes.rationale: Searches the order to refund by exact orderNumber (if query has no '@') or by buyer email (if it contains '@'), joining orderItems, user and enrollments.

nodes.label: OrdenParaReembolso Shape
nodes.rationale: Data structure shared with the refunds admin UI: orderNumber, status enum (pending/paid/failed/expired/refunded), totalCents, paidAt, courseTitle, buyer info, enrollmentId.

nodes.label: RevokeAccessButton UI
nodes.rationale: Client component requiring a refund reason before invoking the revocarAcceso server action; confirms with an inline input, uses useTransition and router.refresh().

nodes.label: deleteObject (lib/r2)
nodes.rationale: Deletes the revoked certificate's PDF from Cloudflare R2; failure is logged but does not fail the refund.

nodes.label: Test Accounts (PROF/ALUMNO/ADMIN)
nodes.rationale: Shared seeded credentials for e2e: instructor, student and admin users used by every Playwright spec.

nodes.label: Aula (Student Learning) E2E
nodes.rationale: Covers an enrolled student viewing the agenda, entering a live session, marking attendance and downloading a material; seeds an enrollment and session material directly in the DB.

nodes.label: Public Catalog E2E
nodes.rationale: Public catalog shows published courses, detail shows syllabus + price, Zoom link is NOT leaked in HTML to anonymous visitors, drafts 404, and instructor can create+session+ publish a course (needs >=1 session).

nodes.label: Certificates Lifecycle E2E
nodes.rationale: Student passes exam, downloads certificate PDF, public verification shows Valid (and hides the owner email), then admin revokes it and the PDF becomes 404.

nodes.label: Exam Taking E2E
nodes.rationale: Instructor builds and publishes an exam; student takes it and passes. Asserts the attempt page never leaks isCorrect in HTML and that unanswered questions are graded as incorrect.

nodes.label: Manual Payment E2E
nodes.rationale: Student creates order (via test-only API), uploads proof (R2 presigned PUT intercepted because dev has no real R2 creds), waits for the Turnstile token, and the admin approves it; cleanup reverts the real enrollment/earnings side effects.

nodes.label: /api/test-only/crear-orden Endpoint
nodes.rationale: WHY: Phase 2 has no buy button on the course page (that is catalog UI, Phase 1), so the e2e test creates the order by POSTing to this test-only Server Action route.

nodes.label: Playwright getDbHandles Pattern
nodes.rationale: WHY: Playwright runs plain Node (not next dev), so .env.local is not auto-loaded; dotenv.config must run and @/db must be dynamically imported AFTER the env is populated, and the CJS dynamic-import transform wraps named exports in {default,...} so they must be unwrapped.

nodes.label: assessment/actions Module
nodes.rationale: Server actions under test: iniciarIntento, responder, enviarIntento, guardarExamen, guardarPregunta, eliminarPregunta, publicarExamen, despublicarExamen.

nodes.label: assessment/queries Module
nodes.rationale: Queries under test: getResultado, getExamenDeCurso, getIntentoParaResolver, getBancoPreguntas.

nodes.label: assessment/grading Module
nodes.rationale: Contains cerrarIntento: grades only what was answered on time when an attempt has expired.

nodes.label: enviarIntento Integration Tests
nodes.rationale: Verifies scoring is over total attempt points, pass threshold, unanswered-questions-as-incorrect, submit idempotency, expired-attempt grading, cross-student rejection, and the regression where emitirCertificado inside the SAME transaction would roll back the whole attempt close when the instructor had no profile.

nodes.label: Exam Management Integration Tests
nodes.rationale: Covers guardarExamen (upsert, ownership), guardarPregunta (options replace, orderIndex, one-correct-option rule, no edits while an attempt is in progress), eliminarPregunta (hard delete vs archive when already answered; unpublish when the last active question is archived), publish rules and getBancoPreguntas.

nodes.label: iniciarIntento Integration Tests
nodes.rationale: Covers attempt creation freezing question order, two-tab convergence to the same in_progress attempt (and the unique-constraint recovery path), attemptNumber increment, questionsPerAttempt, expiresAt time limits, attempts lockout window, enrollment/publish/active-question guards, and getExamenDeCurso eligibility.

nodes.label: responder Integration Tests
nodes.rationale: Covers server-side isCorrect computation (never returned to the client), upsert on option change, option/question ownership checks, submitted/expired attempt rejection, and getIntentoParaResolver not exposing isCorrect or explanations while in progress.

nodes.label: Auth Schema Integration Test
nodes.rationale: Smoke-checks the migrations created the Better Auth tables (user, session, account, verification) and the class_sessions table.

nodes.label: Better Auth Tables (user/session/account/verification)
nodes.rationale: Named external schema produced by the Better Auth CLI migration.

nodes.name: Plataforma de cursos online con certificación — Diseño
Fase 6 — Reembolso y revocación de acceso · diseño
Task 3 brief — UI de admin: buscar y confirmar reembolso
Task 3 report — UI de admin: buscar y confirmar reembolso
Modelo de negocio: academia propia preparada para marketplace
nodes.rationale: Arranca como academia propia (solo admin y equipo publican cursos) con el modelo de datos listo para convertirse en marketplace multi-instructor sin migración destructiva; el dinero entra primero a la cuenta del dueño y luego se transfiere el neto al instructor, por lo que no se requiere split de pagos — elimina la principal limitación de las pasarelas peruanas.

nodes.name: Pago manual Yape/Plin/transferencia con validación manual
nodes.rationale: Stripe no es viable porque no admite entidades peruanas como receptoras; el MVP cobra con Yape, Plin y transferencia bancaria validados manualmente por el admin (comisión 0%, sin RUC). Culqi queda diseñado como segundo proveedor (~4% + IGV) detrás de la interfaz PaymentProvider.

nodes.name: Comisión congelada en order_items al vender
nodes.rationale: commission_rate se copia al order_item al momento de la venta y nunca se vuelve a leer del perfil del instructor al liquidar, para que el histórico contable no se reescriba si cambia la comisión mañana. Precedencia: courses.commission_rate_override si no es NULL, si no instructor_profiles.commission_rate (default 30%).

nodes.name: Ventana de reembolso de 30 días
nodes.rationale: earnings.available_at = fecha de venta + 30 días: no se liquida antes de que expire el derecho a reembolso. Reversar un earning no pagado es un UPDATE; reversar uno ya transferido (paid → reversed) es una conversación incómoda que queda como deuda del instructor sin mecanismo de cobro.

nodes.name: Código de certificado legible sin ambiguos
nodes.rationale: Formato XXXX-XXXX de 8 caracteres con alfabeto sin 0 O 1 I L para evitar ambigüedad al dictarlo (ej: K7M4-P2XR). No garantiza unicidad por sí solo: el UNIQUE de la tabla más un reintento en la capa de inserción lo aseguran.

nodes.name: Generación perezosa del PDF de certificado
nodes.rationale: El PDF se genera en el primer acceso al endpoint, no dentro de la transacción del examen: un fallo al renderizar o subir a R2 no debe revertir un examen aprobado. El certificado existe al aprobar (con pdf_key NULL); el archivo es un artefacto cacheado que se reintenta en el siguiente acceso. Libs: @react-pdf/renderer + qrcode.

nodes.name: Verificación pública de certificado
nodes.rationale: El código + QR apunta a /verificar/[code], público sin login; muestra válido/revocado/inexistente y nunca expone email ni datos personales fuera de lo impreso. Un certificado revocado responde 404 en el PDF aunque el archivo siga cacheado en R2.

nodes.name: Autorización centralizada (assertEnrolled / assertRole)
nodes.rationale: assertEnrolled(userId, courseId) y assertRole(role) son los únicos puntos de decisión de autorización; toda server action y todo loader de contenido pagado los invoca. Los guards se resuelven dentro de la acción vía requireUser(), ningún export de un módulo 'use server' recibe userId como parámetro.

nodes.name: Regla dura: service.ts sin imports de next/* ni de la BD
nodes.rationale: Toda la lógica de negocio (cálculo de nota, comisión, elegibilidad, emisión de certificado) vive en service.ts que no importa nada de next/* ni de la base de datos, para testearla con Vitest sin servidor ni navegador. Las consultas van a queries.ts sin 'use server'; la mutación a actions.ts con 'use server'.

nodes.name: Máquina de estados de sesión
nodes.rationale: Estados visibles según la hora: 'faltan N días' → EN VIVO AHORA → 'finalizada, grabación disponible'; zoom_url y recording_url se resuelven server-side tras assertEnrolled y nunca aparecen en HTML/props para un no inscrito.

nodes.name: Recordatorios de clase con dedup por UNIQUE
nodes.rationale: Cron cada 15 min golpea /api/cron/recordatorios (header secreto) y envía emails a 24h y 1h antes. El INSERT ... ON CONFLICT en session_reminders_sent va ANTES del envío: si insertó 0 filas ya se envió y salta. Ventanas solapadas a propósito; el UNIQUE(enrollment, session, kind) absorbe la repetición.

nodes.name: Invariantes del examen
nodes.rationale: is_correct y explanation_md nunca viajan al cliente durante el intento (ni props, ni acciones, ni HTML RSC); recargar no re-baraja (orden congelado en exam_attempt_questions, opciones derivadas de semilla estable attemptId+questionId); un intento in_progress no genera otro (UNIQUE enrollment+attempt_number); el tiempo lo manda el servidor (expires_at, auto-envío al entrar a un intento vencido); enviarIntento idempotente; attemptId ajeno responde 404.

nodes.name: Funciones puras de assessment
nodes.rationale: calcularNota (Σ puntos correctos/Σ totales ×100, redondeado 2 decimales, Σ=0 → 0 y passed=false), barajarConSemilla (Fisher-Yates con PRNG determinista), semillaOpciones(attemptId, questionId) derivada y no persistida, evaluarElegibilidad({intentosUsados, maxAttempts, ultimoIntentoAt, lockoutHours, ahora}). Umbral de aprobación 70%, 3 intentos, bloqueo 24h, solo MCQ y true/false.

nodes.name: revocarAcceso(orderId, motivo) — transacción atómica
nodes.rationale: Todo dentro de una única db.transaction: orders.status=refunded, enrollments.status=refunded, instructorEarnings.status=reversed (aunque ya esté paid → deuda del instructor), revocarCertificadoTx(tx, enrollmentId, motivo). Fuera de la transacción: deleteObject de R2 (best-effort, logueado) y email refundProcessedTemplate. Idempotente sobre orderId (no reenvía email). Nunca revierte una orden que no esté paid.

nodes.name: revocarCertificadoTx(tx, enrollmentId, motivo) — función compartida
nodes.rationale: Se extrae la parte de BD de la revocación del certificado a una función interna que solo actualiza la fila dentro de un tx dado sin tocar R2 (mismo principio que emitirCertificado): una llamada de red a R2 no debe ocurrir dentro de una transacción de BD abierta. Devuelve la pdfKey ANTERIOR para que el llamador borre el objeto de R2 después de que su transacción cierra. Idempotente: si ya estaba revocado, no lo vuelve a tocar.

nodes.name: enrollments.status = 'refunded', no 'revoked'
nodes.rationale: El enum enrollmentStatus ya distingue refunded de revoked; 'refunded' es semánticamente preciso para un reembolso y coincide con orders.status. 'revoked' queda libre para una futura revocación disciplinaria (fraude, violación de términos) que no sea un reembolso.

nodes.name: Idempotencia vía ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
nodes.rationale: Patrón aplicado en aprobarPago (enrollments e instructor_earnings con onConflictDoNothing, cubre doble aprobación concurrente), emitirCertificado (ON CONFLICT (enrollment_id) DO NOTHING), session_reminders_sent y payment_events (provider_event_id UNIQUE). Cualquier throw dentro de db.transaction → ROLLBACK automático de Drizzle.

nodes.name: Cupones diferidos
nodes.rationale: La validación/aplicación del cupón se hace en crearOrden (Fase 2, Task 1) pero el flujo completo de administración de cupones queda diferido a una fase futura separada; el spec base agrupa cupones junto a liquidaciones, gestión de usuarios, Libro de Reclamaciones y páginas legales, demasiado para un solo plan.

nodes.name: src/modules/billing/ (service, queries, actions, ui)
nodes.rationale: Módulo de pagos: crearOrden, aprobación transaccional aprobarPago, plantillas orderApprovedTemplate/orderRejectedTemplate, interfaz PaymentProvider, verificación manual de comprobantes en /admin/pagos.

nodes.name: src/modules/learning/ (service, queries, actions, jobs, ui)
nodes.rationale: Módulo de aula del alumno: marcarProgreso(sessionId), cron de recordatorios en jobs.ts (sin 'use server'), agenda con estados de sesión. jobs.ts no lleva 'use server'.

nodes.name: src/modules/assessment/ (service, queries, grading, actions)
nodes.rationale: Módulo de examen: iniciarIntento/responder/enviarIntento; grading.ts sin 'use server' contiene la transacción de calificación y el gancho de emisión de certificado; no genera migraciones (tablas migradas en drizzle/0001_previous_naoko.sql).

nodes.name: src/modules/certification/ (service, queries, actions, issuance, pdf)
nodes.rationale: Módulo de certificados: service.ts puro (generarCodigo), issuance.ts sin 'use server' (emitirCertificado, revocarCertificadoTx), actions.ts solo revocarCertificado, pdf.tsx sin 'use server' (render @react-pdf/renderer + subida a R2). Sin migraciones (certificates ya migrado en src/db/schema/certification.ts).

nodes.name: src/modules/refunds/ (queries, actions, ui)

nodes.rationale: Una sola app Next.js con cuatro espacios separados por route groups y middleware de rol; módulos por dominio (auth, catalog, enrollment, learning, assessment, certification, billing, earnings, notifications), cada uno expone schema.ts, service.ts, actions.ts y ui/.

dotenv/config loads env used by tests/setup/db.ts and integration tests.
SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASSWORD/MAIL_FROM drive nodemailer; email_log records deliveries.
R2 bucket/credentials (env) back session_materials.file_key and certificates.pdf_key objects.
Domain tables (courses.instructor_id, enrollments.user_id, ...) reference user from migration 0000.
All 15 enums are consumed by domain table columns.
order_number column is populated from order_number_seq.
FK email_log.user_id -> user.id (on delete set null).
instructor commission_rate and bank details drive course commission and payout settlement.
FK exams.course_id -> courses.id (cascade), unique per course.
Paid orders generate instructor_earnings via order_items commission split.
Proof method should correspond to an active payment_destinations method on review.
listPendingProofs() reads pending proof rows; review updates status.
final_score likely sourced from a passed exam attempt's score before certificate issuance.
lists certificates; revoke action sets revoked_at/revoke_reason.
Admin layout nests inside the root layout (route group (admin)).
await assertRole(['admin']) guards all admin routes.

hyperedges.name: order_lifecycle
hyperedges.detail: Order created pending -> coupon applied (coupon_redemptions) -> manual proof submitted (payment_proofs) or culqi webhook (payment_events) -> admin approval marks paid -> enrollment created; cron expires stale orders.

hyperedges.name: certification_flow
hyperedges.detail: Enrollment -> attendance recorded -> exam attempts (bounded by max_attempts/lockout_hours) graded server-side against question_options -> passed attempt drives certificate issuance with snapshotted credential text and pdf_key.

hyperedges.name: admin_operations
hyperedges.detail: assertRole(['admin']) guards the admin section; pagos_page reviews pending proofs (approve/reject), certificados_page lists and revokes certificates; both delegate to billing/certification modules.

hyperedges.label: Kit de componentes UI sobre Base UI + cva
Exam attempt lifecycle (start, answer, grade, submit)
Certificate Lifecycle (emit, render PDF, verify, revoke)
Billing payment approval → access revocation → email flow
Certification issuance → unique code → PDF → R2 storage flow
Enrollment guard → attendance → course progress flow
